correctness.rationale: The 20 off-diagonal vertices yield exactly (20,130,320,265,44) oriented chain basis sizes. Exact elimination modulo 101 yields boundary rank lower bounds (19,111,208,44); boundary composition forces the first two matching rational upper bounds, the fourth has 44 columns, and an eight-triangle integral 2-cycle paired to 2 with a 120-term integral 2-cocycle forces the third rank at most 208. Thus the rational Betti vector is (1,0,1,13,0). The signed trace algorithm explicitly covers all 240 graph automorphisms, and 14 exact character-inner-product checks force H2=1⊠epsilon, H3=(S^(4,1)+S^(3,2))⊠1+S^(2,1,1,1)⊠epsilon. These computations are reconstructed by the enclosed verifier and its independent certificate data. The theorem is finite, and no modular rank is misrepresented as a characteristic-zero upper bound.

value.rationale: The diagonal-deleted rook complex is a classical natural subcomplex, not an arbitrary graph slice. At five rows it has adjacent nonzero homology degrees; the complete character reveals a permutation-fixed but transpose-odd H2 generator, a 9/4 even/odd split in H3 and no fully invariant positive-dimensional rational class. These properties do not follow from known ranks, give interpretable structural symmetry information and are obtained through a small reproducible exact finite certificate. The lack of a family theorem is an explicit limitation, not a reason this canonical small case has no value.
